highlights.title: Trump Backs Nvidia CEO After He Admits Affair
highlights.description: President Donald Trump called Jensen Huang a “fine person” and said he should stay on as the chief executive officer of Nvidia Corp. after the executive admitted having an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. (Source: Bloomberg)

alsoIn.title: Trump says Jensen Huang should stay on as Nvidia CEO after affair admission, saying he is a "fine person" and "I haven't heard he's done anything wrong"
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admits to affair; board orders investigation
